import unittest
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError, is_dataclass

from solution import EntryOptions, build_entry


class BuildEntryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dataclass_defaults_and_frozen_behavior(self):
        options = EntryOptions("Title")
        self.assertTrue(is_dataclass(options))
        self.assertIsNone(options.curator)
        self.assertEqual(options.tags, ())
        self.assertIsNone(options.attributes)
        with self.assertRaises(FrozenInstanceError):
            options.title = "Changed"

    def test_builds_normalized_entry_in_required_order(self):
        options = EntryOptions(
            "  The Book  ",
            "  Curator  ",
            (" fiction ", "Classic"),
            {"pages": 10},
        )
        result = build_entry("book", options)
        self.assertEqual(list(result), [
            "kind", "title", "curator", "tags", "attributes"
        ])
        self.assertEqual(result, {
            "kind": "book",
            "title": "The Book",
            "curator": "Curator",
            "tags": ["fiction", "Classic"],
            "attributes": {"pages": 10},
        })
        self.assertIsInstance(result["tags"], list)

    def test_other_supported_kinds_and_omitted_values(self):
        for kind in ("audio", "map"):
            with self.subTest(kind=kind):
                self.assertEqual(build_entry(kind, EntryOptions(" X ")), {
                    "kind": kind,
                    "title": "X",
                    "curator": None,
                    "tags": [],
                    "attributes": {},
                })

    def test_attributes_are_deep_copied(self):
        attributes = {"nested": {"values": [1, 2]}}
        result = build_entry("map", EntryOptions("Atlas", attributes=attributes))
        attributes["nested"]["values"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(result["attributes"], {"nested": {"values": [1, 2]}})
        result["attributes"]["nested"]["values"].append(4)
        self.assertEqual(attributes["nested"]["values"], [1, 2, 3])

    def test_wrong_argument_and_field_types(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            build_entry(1, EntryOptions("Title"))
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            build_entry("book", {"title": "Title"})
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            build_entry("book", EntryOptions(3))
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            build_entry("book", EntryOptions("Title", curator=4))
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            build_entry("book", EntryOptions("Title", tags=["x"]))
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            build_entry("book", EntryOptions("Title", tags=(1,)))
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            build_entry("book", EntryOptions("Title", attributes=[]))

    def test_invalid_values(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_entry("video", EntryOptions("Title"))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_entry("book", EntryOptions(" \t "))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_entry("book", EntryOptions("Title", curator="  "))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_entry("book", EntryOptions("Title", tags=("x", "  ")))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_entry("book", EntryOptions("Title", tags=(" x ", "x")))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
